selectors.exact: The Team plan is supported until 31 March 2030.

missing.note: Vendor pricing page states support through December 2029 (level-5 condition); reseller catalogue entry from the same quarter states end of support in June 2026 (level-1 condition). Nothing dates or supersedes either, and nothing reconciles them.

cell.justification: The vendor's help centre states every workspace exports to Markdown and JSON with a published JSON schema, and the API reference documents bulk exports in the open Notes Interchange schema; both are open, documented formats covering every workspace, which is the level-5 condition. The qualifier narrows the bulk endpoint's documentation and does not contradict it.

selectors.exact: Export every workspace to Markdown and JSON; the JSON schema is published in our API reference.
Exports produced by the bulk endpoint are documented in the open Notes Interchange schema, version 2.

cell.justification: The vendor's help centre says notes and folders export to plain Markdown, but comments and attachments export only as a proprietary .mossarchive bundle: not all data is in an open format (not the level-5 condition), and export is not proprietary only (not the level-3 condition). Placed between anchors 3 and 5.

selectors.exact: Notes and folders export to plain Markdown. Comments and attachments export only as a .mossarchive bundle, readable by Mossnote.

cell.justification: The vendor's help centre states a self-serve move at any time, with a stated limit that completeness depends on export formats; that is the level-3 condition. The stated limit rules out level 5.

selectors.exact: You can move your team off Quillbase yourself at any time. How complete the move is depends on the export formats your data supports; see the export guide.
Industry-leading support, there for your team whenever you need it.

missing.note: Retrieval covered the Larkpad homepage and press releases; the only span returned is a general support slogan that states no end-of-support date or commitment for any plan.

cell.justification: Both sources state that migration needs the vendor's paid services team, which is the level-1 condition. The consultancy narrows the paid requirement to organisations over 50 seats, while the vendor's page states it without a threshold; this scope difference is why confidence is medium.

selectors.exact: Moving an organisation off Mossnote is handled by our paid Migration Services team.
Mossnote requires a paid engagement with its own services team to migrate an organisation of more than 50 seats.
